ai_explanation.summary: For pain relief and reducing fever.
ai_explanation.simple_instructions: Take 1 tablet with a large glass of water when in pain. Maximum 3 times per day.
ai_explanation.warnings: Do not drink alcohol. Wait at least 4 hours between doses.

ai_explanation.summary: Lowers cholesterol levels in your blood to protect your heart.
ai_explanation.simple_instructions: Take 1 tablet every evening with water, with or without food.
ai_explanation.warnings: Do not drink with grapefruit juice.

ai_explanation.summary: Blood thinner to prevent blood clots and protect your heart and blood vessels.
ai_explanation.simple_instructions: Take 1 tablet daily with a large glass of water, preferably during a meal.
ai_explanation.warnings: Take with food to protect stomach. Avoid other NSAID pain relievers.

ai_explanation.summary: Broad-spectrum antibiotic prescribed to treat bacterial infections.
ai_explanation.simple_instructions: Take 1 capsule every 8 hours with a full glass of water. Complete the entire course.
ai_explanation.warnings: Take with meals if stomach upset occurs. Do not stop taking early even if feeling better.
